## project/.cursor/hooks.json
{
  "version": 1,
  "hooks": {
    "sessionStart": [
      {
        "command": "node ./.cursor/hooks/aidd-telemetry/session-start.cjs",
        "timeout": 10
      },
      {
        "command": "node ./.cursor/hooks/aidd-telemetry/catch-up.cjs",
        "timeout": 120
      }
    ],
    "beforeSubmitPrompt": [
      {
        "command": "node ./.cursor/hooks/aidd-telemetry/prompt-gate.cjs",
        "timeout": 30
      }
    ]
  }
}
